title: amendment-atoms v1 rule
description: A rule constrains how proposals are ordered, how many approvals are required, how conflicts are resolved, and when proposals expire. Rules compose with amendment-sets to form a complete change-control protocol.

rule_type.description: ordering — proposals applied in serial; quorum — N-of-role required to ratify; conflict-resolution — how to resolve collisions on the same target section; expiry — proposals auto-reject after N days without ratification

expression.description: Human-readable or DSL expression stating the rule constraint. E.g. 'proposals targeting the same section must be applied in version-ascending order'.

scope.description: Optional glob or atom-ID pattern scoping this rule to a subset of proposals.
